$comment: An example world setting (owner, 2026-11-10: "at least 5000m tall elevations like mount rainier is 4392m tall"), never a world's own: terrain.json's elevation with one convergent plate boundary and one dormant stratovolcano behind it, 4800 m high and 12 km in radius with a 400 m crater, hardened against the erosion (coneHardness) so it keeps its relief on the 100 m map. Tests build it by data alone (FIXTURE_WORLDS, WorldMap::for_height); Chisel offers it as a preset. Prototype content.
name: test:tall_peak
